digest.component_or_area: author guides and user documentation for plan-review gate
propositions: Author guide currently instructs authors to write `## Success Criteria` for containers, but the SC/AC split is being collapsed and no reader consumes this heading
Guide sections at lines 58-76 of writing-a-passing-plan.md must be rewritten to express container-specific requirements as decomposition/coverage rather than a separate success criteria heading
User documentation at docs/user-guide.md:219-230 and docs/llm-framework.md:407 must be updated to remove success criteria vocabulary

Container guidance must remain substantive after rewrite, stating that containers need acceptance criteria plus child decomposition covering it, with testing deferred to children, not merely that containers need acceptance criteria
Four permanent carve-outs (T2 pilot metrics, dod_uncertifiable concept, and LLM-framework criterion prompts) must be preserved exactly as written and not cleaned by success criteria regex searches
